Package neqsim.process.equipment.energy

Class CoupledProcessEnergySolver

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.energy.CoupledProcessEnergySolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CoupledProcessEnergySolver extends Object implements Serializable
Iterates a complete ProcessSystem until process states and connected energy networks converge together.

A graph-ordered process run evaluates energy producers, an EnergyNetworkSolver, and energy consumers in causal order. Equipment downstream of the network solver can, however, publish a revised request for the next run. This class performs that outer fixed-point iteration and checks both stream-state changes and energy-network changes.

Under-relaxation is applied to EnergyPortMode.SPECIFICATION requests between process runs. It damps power feedback without overwriting calculated process stream states or calculated generation.

1.0

    • addEnergyBus

      public void addEnergyBus(EnergyBus energyBus)
      Adds an energy bus that is not owned by an EnergyNetworkSolver in the process.

      Explicit buses are solved after each complete process run when their allocation is stale. Normally buses should be attached to an EnergyNetworkSolver so graph scheduling places the balance between producers and consumers.

      Parameters:
      energyBus - additional bus to include in convergence checks
